name: codeck
description: Codeck: Local MCP Server & CLI context handoff bridge for Codex, Claude Code, Gemini, Kimi, and Grok.

scripts.test:gemini-image: npm run build && node --input-type=module -e "import assert from 'node:assert/strict'; import { extractGeminiImageParts } from './dist/adapters.js'; const parts = extractGeminiImageParts({ candidates: [{ content: { parts: [{ inlineData: { mimeType: 'image/png', data: 'aGVsbG8=' } }, { inline_data: { mime_type: 'image/jpeg', data: 'd29ybGQ=' } }] } }] }); assert.equal(parts.length, 2); assert.equal(parts[0].mimeType, 'image/png'); assert.equal(parts[1].mimeType, 'image/jpeg');"
